Definition: Sedom, a place near the Dead Sea
BiblicalUsage: Sodom was the city of the plain where Lot pitched his tent, a city whose men were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly, and which God overthrew with brimstone and fire. It stands in Scripture as the place of judgment, named again and again whenever prophets warn of what sin brings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sodom is God's warning written in a city's name, and I take it seriously: pride and plenty without mercy end the same way they ended there.
